rationale: The papers 'Deep Synoptic Array Science' (2308.06813), 'Polarization properties of 128 non-repeating fast radio bursts' (2401.17378), and 'Frequency-dependent polarization of repeating fast radio bursts' (2202.09601) provide insights into Faraday rotation measures and polarization properties of FRBs, which are relevant to understanding discrepancies in detection rates at different Galactic latitudes.
